content.title: Power Integrations joins work with Nvidia on power supply push
content.summary: SAN FRANCISCO (Reuters) -Power Integrations, a niche chipmaker that provides chips for handling power, on Monday said it is working with Nvidia  on the artificial intelligence giant's push to make data centers operate at higher voltages.  Nvidia earlier this year unveiled an effort with more than a dozen partner companies to convert massive AI data centers - which can consume as much electricity as cities - to distribute internal power using 800 volts of direct current, rather than the more common alternating current.
